integrity: For fixed spine labels, each page has a sharp lower bound on the sum of its two labels. For at least three pages these bounds force total weight above four except for the two-spine label-2 function, with the sole numerical boundary at m=3 eliminated by the no-isolated-positive condition. For two pages, the same page table plus totality yields exactly six equality patterns.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies minimum functions only.
The boundary B_1=C_4 has optimum three and is excluded.
Finite exhaustive verification covers m from one through twelve and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed square-book treatment may exist.
title: Minimum total Roman \(\{2\}\) functions of square-page book graphs
